question: Does cache-line distance beyond a blocking completion fence change first-use cost relative to identically prewarmed code, despite identical in-window instruction bytes and four-line span?

design.inputs: same resident single16x16 i8*i8->raw i32 full tile, no accumulation; six ABI operand registers
design.history: For each layout and repeat: resetoutputs+fence; fence.i; measuredfirst; alloutputcheck; reset+fence; unreportedwarmupcall+alloutputcheck; reset+fence; measuredwarm; alloutputcheck. Repeat3times; layout0before44. Printonlyafterall12measurements.
design.reference: Independent CPU exact reference computed once before all calls;256outputs+32guards checked each18calls
design.outside_window: inputinitialization/configuration/MVIN, reset, fence.i, callingbranches, elevenNOPs, MVOUT+completion fence, subtraction/return, checks, printing
design.postlude_caveat: Eleven identicalNOPs afterendCSR beforeMVOUT extend bothroutines to264B/fiveIcachelines. Equal linecounts do not establish physicalfetchhistory; exactexecutedprelude/postlude remains explicit.

criteria.mandatory_functional: All18calls pass256outputs+32guards; plain/annotated fulloutput semantics identical except raw cycles. No missing or reordered occurrence.
criteria.mandatory_layout: Disassembly proves both51instruction inclusive spans, all4bytes, byteidentical windows, offset0/44, same4line span, exactfenceoffsets and no insidebranches.
criteria.mandatory_model: All12selected windows timing_complete/no unresolved with unchangedmodel; otherwise reportunsupportedbeforephysicalapproval.
criteria.diagnostic_signal: Compute layoutD=median(first0)-median(first44), warmD=median(warm0)-median(warm44), differential=layoutD-warmD. Positive differential>max(16cycles,3%meanfirst) supports a layout-sensitive first-use cost; opposite sign refutes this directional hypothesis; withinthreshold is inconclusive. This does not identify speculativefetch as unique physicalcause.
criteria.model_disagreement: Report each frozen prediction, all occurrence errors, same differential; >max(16cycles,20%absphysicaldifferential) differential residual marks unexplained layout sensitivity. Not a qualification criterion or coefficientfit.
criteria.state_stability: Report full threeoccurrence ranges and median; if range>max(16cycles,5%median), label that treatmentunstable; no samplediscard or thresholdchange.
criteria.qualification: Diagnostic only, no timingqualification, no source-heldoutclaim, no coefficientchanges, no correction inferred from labels.

budget.authorization: Root review exact source/layout/functional/observerreceipts beforeany physicalrun
